items.title: Grayscale’s Pandl still sees bitcoin’s $58K low as the bottom, gives clients ‘green light’
items.summary: Grayscale's Zach Pandl maintains bitcoin bottomed near $58,000 as the firm gives clients a "green light" to allocate.

items.title: How Circle’s institutional Arc blockchain got taken over by memecoins on day one
items.summary: Circle blockchain Arc's first day was dominated by memecoins, and the traders behind them had already moved on by Thursday morning.

items.title: Zcash gains 20% as Paradigm founder reveals firm made ZEC investment
items.summary: Zcash rose about 20% in 24 hours as Paradigm co-founder Matt Huang disclosed that the firm invested in ZEC amid a broader crypto market rally.

items.title: House Committee Advances US Bitcoin Reserve Bill on Party-Line Split
items.summary: A substitute text adopted before the vote strips out the Federal Reserve funding routes and thins the transparency rules.
